children.text: For non-emergency illnesses, a General Practitioner (GP) is usually your primary healthcare contact in Australia. Always ask about fees before booking; insurer direct-billing clinics can reduce or eliminate upfront costs. GPs also issue required referral letters for specialist appointments. For life-threatening emergencies, call 000.
